every fence opens and closes once

both engines load in a bare context with no window or document
each declares exactly one global, frozen, version 1.0.0
engine-audio.js loads alone, without the render engine
boots with no page errors

after Quick Build coverage is green with no Claude
coverage spans palettes, sprites, portraits, icons, motion, world, interface, and sound

required poses are owed through their library animations
every required music role and the five UI parts are owed

Quick Build dresses the newcomer and fills its forward fields
deleting a default biome is advisory with Restore, never a gap
Restore brings the forest back
a required pose animation stays required even when deleted, and offers Restore
Restore rebuilds the walk animation
a deleted portrait owes both the portrait and the forward field
Quick Build heals both
a clean bundle has no dangling reference
the scan sees art links, subjects, and the biome priority list
every link path is reported once: by its phase validator, never twice
